verdict: ROAS solid at 4.15x, but a 3-day purchase pause needs watching.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $4.15 for every $1 spent on $1,444 in ad spend, producing 33 purchases and $5,989 in revenue — a healthy result for the period. Purchases were up 25% week-over-week through mid-week, but the last three days (Oct 14–16) recorded zero purchases, a short pause we are monitoring closely and addressing with a creative review. Google Business Profile actions show a steep drop in the most recent days, but this appears to be a data reporting gap rather than a real-world change; we are confirming that now. Instagram reach climbed 18% this week to a recent high, and we are tightening the path from that reach to purchase to make sure the audience growth converts. Several setup milestones — including UTM tracking, automated flows, and subscribe pages — remain unconfirmed complete, and closing those out is the priority this month so every future result is fully measurable.
